jobs.title: Senior Full-Stack Engineer, Internal Applications
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About the role

You will investigate alerts, document evidence, partner with operations and compliance teams, improve controls, and communicate findings clearly to stakeholders across the organization. We value curiosity, rigor, bilingual communication, and a calm approach to ambiguous problems. This posting is a sanitized fixture for offline tests and does not describe a real job.
